title: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.19990v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While RL has become a promising tool for refining world models, existing methods largely rely on conservative rollouts near the training distribution, limiting exploration, behavioral diversity, and richer dynamic discovery. In this work, we challenge this conservative paradigm. We argue that the core limitation is not exploration itself, but the lack of reliable verification strategies to support broader exploration. Without reliable verification, expanded exploration becomes highly susceptible to reward hacking, where policies exploit imperfect rewards without achieving genuine improvement. To evaluate this motivation, we instantiate our method in embodied world models, where physical plausibility, and task completion provide a rigorous testbed for scalable RL under complex dynamics. translated_title: 奖励作为具身世界模型中的智能体
translated_abstract: 虽然强化学习（RL）已成为优化世界模型的一种有前景的工具，但现有方法在很大程度上依赖于训练分布附近的保守滚动采样，这限制了探索能力、行为多样性以及更丰富的动态发现。在这项工作中，我们挑战了这一保守范式。我们认为，核心限制不在于探索本身，而在于缺乏可靠的验证策略来支持更广泛的探索。在没有可靠验证的情况下，扩大的探索极易受到奖励攻击（reward hacking）的影响，即策略利用不完善的奖励而未能实现真正的改进。为了验证这一动机，我们将我们的方法实例化到具身世界模型中，其中物理合理性和任务完成为复杂动态下的可扩展强化学习提供了一个严格的测试平台。在验证方面，我们提出了“奖励作为智能体”，这是一个主动评估生成行为以提供稳健奖励的智能体奖励框架……
tldr: 提出“奖励作为智能体”框架，通过主动评估生成行为提供可靠验证，使具身世界模型能够支持更广泛的探索并有效防止奖励攻击。
en_tdlr: Proposes "Reward as an Agent," an agentic reward framework that actively evaluates generated behaviors to provide reliable verification, enabling broader exploration while preventing reward hacking in embodied world models.
